assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.text: I'd like to talk about a book that has changed the way I think about money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.zh: 我想谈一本改变了我对金钱看法的书。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.text: It's called The Secret of Being Wealthy.
It was written by a business school graduate named John Home,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.zh: 这本书由一位名叫约翰·霍姆的商学院毕业生所写，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.text: who decided to study the behaviour of wealthy people.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.zh: 他决定研究富人的行为。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.text: He paid close attention to what rich people do,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.zh: 他密切关注富人的所作所为，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.text: how they live and so on.
The results of his study were pretty surprising.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31f3cb911957047.zh: 他的研究结果相当令人惊讶。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 第八单元·第二部分
第二部分。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: When you think of someone who is very rich,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 当你想到一个非常富有的人时，
你会想到什么？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: Most people think that rich people live lavish lifestyles.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 大多数人认为富人过着奢华的生活。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: That is, they drive very expensive cars,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 也就是说，他们开非常昂贵的车，
在昂贵的餐厅吃饭，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: own a yacht or live in big houses.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 拥有游艇或住在大房子里。
但正如约翰·霍姆发现的那样，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: people who have money don't actually do these things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 真正有钱的人其实并不这样做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: Most millionaires actually seem to have ordinary lifestyles.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 实际上，大多数百万富翁看起来过着普通的生活方式。
换句话说，
他们开普通的车，
住普通价位的房子，等等。
另一方面，
那些看起来很有钱的人，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: the people who drive the latest Ferrari or only wear designer clothes may not actually be rich at all.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 开最新款法拉利或只穿名牌服装的人，实际上可能根本不富有。
相反，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: they have spent all their money trying to show off,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 他们把钱都花在炫耀上了，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: showing other people that they might be wealthy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 向别人展示自己可能很富有。
换句话说，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.text: having expensive things is not always a sign that someone is rich.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ffe9efbf10f8b82.zh: 拥有昂贵的东西并不总是富有的标志。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_707a5b3ee5ab8b2.text: So what do millionaires do and what can we learn from them?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_707a5b3ee5ab8b2.zh: 那么，百万富翁都做些什么？我们能从他们身上学到什么？
百万富翁通常很懂得理财。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_707a5b3ee5ab8b2.text: they're smart about how to save and spend money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_707a5b3ee5ab8b2.zh: 他们很懂得如何储蓄和花钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.text: The first important thing is that millionaires always have a good handle on their budget.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.zh: 第一件重要的事是，百万富翁总能很好地掌控自己的预算。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.text: they know how much they're spending.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.zh: 他们清楚自己花了多少钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.text: around 75 % of millionaires know exactly how much money they have and they know exactly how much they spend on food,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.zh: 约75%的百万富翁确切知道自己有多少钱，也确切知道自己在食物上花了多少钱，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.text: they don't spend too much and they don't get into debt.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.zh: 他们不会过度消费，也不会负债。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.text: They can plan for the future and save their money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8c25c62ec23dcfb.zh: 他们能够为未来做计划，并把钱存起来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.text: Also, around 65 % of millionaires live in homes which cost around the national average.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.zh: 此外，约65%的百万富翁住在价格接近全国平均水平的房子里。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.text: the important lesson here is to live within your means.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.zh: 这里的重要教训是量入为出。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.text: That is, don't spend more money than you have.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.zh: 也就是说，别花超过自己拥有的钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.text: If you spend all your savings on a luxury BMW,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.zh: 如果你把所有积蓄都花在一辆豪华宝马上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.text: You just want to look rich.
of luxury cars are bought by people who can't afford them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e6e15d90530d8a2.zh: 豪车是由买不起它们的人购买的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.text: the lesson here is that you should never spend more money than you have.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.zh: 这里的教训是：绝不要花超过自己拥有的钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.text: Another surprising fact is that millionaires usually have simple lifestyles.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.zh: 另一个令人惊讶的事实是，百万富翁通常过着简朴的生活。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.text: They have nice houses and nice cars, but they don't spend all their money on these things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.zh: 他们有漂亮的房子和好车，但不会把所有钱都花在这些东西上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.text: most rich people stay in the same place for a very long time and don't live in big expensive palaces.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.zh: 大多数富人会在同一个地方住很久，也不住昂贵的大豪宅。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.text: half of millionaires have lived in the same house for 20 years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a9aba0d11bdb3d0.zh: 一半的百万富翁在同一所房子里住了20年。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a4dc644aebc6559.text: doubt that it's more difficult to save money if you are single.
One effect of being a couple is that it's easier to save money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a4dc644aebc6559.zh: 伴侣关系带来的一个影响是，存钱更容易。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a4dc644aebc6559.text: If there are two of you, it's easier to pay attention to what money you have and what you're spending.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a4dc644aebc6559.zh: 如果有两个人，就更容易留意自己有多少钱、花了多少钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_092569152efd74e.text: Most rich people don't have bank loans.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_092569152efd74e.zh: 大多数富人没有银行贷款。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_092569152efd74e.text: They only spend a small percentage of what they have and they save or invest the rest.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_092569152efd74e.zh: 他们只花自己拥有财产中的一小部分，其余的则储蓄或投资。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.text: Now here is an interesting fact.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.zh: 现在有一个有趣的事实。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.text: The study shows that most millionaires have very happy relationships.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.zh: 研究显示，大多数百万富翁的感情关系很幸福。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.text: but they stay married for a long time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.zh: 而且婚姻维持了很长时间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.text: this is very important because of the golden rule about saving money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8cd504240ccc7b5.zh: 这非常重要，因为它关系到储蓄的黄金法则。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.text: And of course, people who don't have huge bank loans and debts are happier.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.zh: 当然，没有巨额银行贷款和债务的人更幸福。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.text: If you don't have to worry about the monthly credit card payments,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.zh: 如果你不必担心每月的信用卡还款，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.text: you're less likely to buy things to make you feel better.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.zh: 你就不太可能靠买东西让自己感觉好一些。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.text: People with debt often spend more time shopping just to make themselves feel happier, but real millionaires don't need to do this.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2f15fe721a62ef6.zh: 有债务的人往往花更多时间购物，只是为了让自己更开心；但真正的百万富翁不需要这样做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8fb46551d764cbe.text: it doesn't mean being rich or having millions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8fb46551d764cbe.zh: 它并不意味着很有钱或拥有数百万财富。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8fb46551d764cbe.text: It means being happy with what you have.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8fb46551d764cbe.zh: 它意味着对自己拥有的东西感到满足。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.text: So what can we learn from the idea of being wealthy?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.zh: 那么，我们能从“富有”这个概念中学到什么？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.text: Don't spend more money than you have.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.zh: 不要花超过自己拥有的钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.text: Don't get into debt or take out bank loans.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.zh: 不要负债，也不要向银行贷款。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.text: Pay close attention to your money and don't spend time trying to show other people that you're rich.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_03d7ba183169293.zh: 密切留意自己的钱，不要把时间花在向别人炫耀你很富有上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Well, the idea of paying students for their work isn't new.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 付钱让学生学习并不是什么新想法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: For example, students in Denmark are paid about 760 euros a month to attend university.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 例如，丹麦的学生上大学每月可获得约760欧元。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: They receive the payments for a maximum of six years,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 他们领取这笔补助最多六年，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: starting at the age of 18.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 从18岁开始。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: The goal of paying students is to encourage them to finish their education and be able to get a good job in the future.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 付钱给学生是为了鼓励他们完成学业，将来找到好工作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: I see.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 我明白了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Let's hear from our first caller.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 让我们听听第一位来电者的意见。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Mariam Hassan is the president of a medium sized university.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 玛丽亚姆·哈桑是一所中等规模大学的校长。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Dr Hassan.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 哈桑博士。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Hello,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 大家好，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: yes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 是的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: I recently read about this new program and I really don't think it's a good idea.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 我最近读到这个新项目，我确实认为这不是一个好主意。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: I understand that many students drop out of university because of financial problems.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 我理解许多学生因经济问题从大学退学。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: At my university alone,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 仅在我所在的大学，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: the dropout rate is over 25%.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 辍学率就超过25%。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: However,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 不过，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: will paying students really encourage them to continue?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 给学生发钱真的会鼓励他们继续读下去吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: In my experience, it won't.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 根据我的经验，不会。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Of course, the statistics are terrible, but I'm not confident that this program will solve the real problems.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 当然，这些统计数字很糟糕，但我不确信该项目能解决真正的问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: It may just cover them up.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 它可能只是把问题掩盖起来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: I think the money would be better spent on student services,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 我认为这笔钱用在学生服务上会更好，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: like hiring additional professors and advisors.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 例如聘请更多教授和顾问。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Two of the reasons why students drop out are stress and poor time management.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 学生退学的两个原因是压力和时间管理不善。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.text: Advisors can help students learn to manage their time better.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8ccd79bacf75d67.zh: 辅导员可以帮助学生学会更好地管理时间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I think the money would be better spent on student services,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我认为这笔钱用在学生服务上会更好，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: like hiring additional professors and advisors.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 例如聘请更多教授和顾问。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Two of the reasons why students drop out are stress and poor time management.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 学生退学的两个原因是压力和时间管理不善。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Advisors can help students learn to manage their time better.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 辅导员可以帮助学生学会更好地管理时间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: As a consequence,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 这样一来，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: students will do better at university and will be more likely to graduate.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 学生会在大学表现得更好，也更可能毕业。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I can see your point, but we have already spent a lot on student services.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我明白你的意思，但我们已经在学生服务上投入了很多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I think that paying students to study will show them that we treat them like adults.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我认为付钱让学生学习，会让他们知道我们把他们当成年人对待。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: It will give them a sense of responsibility.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 这会给他们一种责任感。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: University students are young adults and so when they have a choice between staying at university and studying or going to work and making money,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 大学生是年轻成年人，因此当他们要在留在大学学习和出去工作挣钱之间作选择时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: they often make the wrong choice.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 他们往往会作出错误选择。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: They want to have money so that they can buy things for themselves.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 他们想有钱，以便给自己买东西。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Besides,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: we don't want to pay them a lot.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我们不想给他们很多钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I think we're simply giving them an option.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我认为我们只是给他们一个选择。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Stay at university and be paid or get a minimum wage job.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 留在大学并获得补助，或者去做一份最低工资的工作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Christine Thorne is a parent with two children at university.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 克里斯汀·索恩是一位有两个孩子在上大学的家长。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Hello.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 你好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I was very worried when I heard about this new program.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 听说这个新项目时，我非常担心。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I realize that students need encouragement to stay at university,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我明白学生需要鼓励才能留在大学，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: but are we going in the right direction?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 但我们的方向对吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: First of all,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 首先，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I feel that we're sending the students the wrong message.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我觉得我们在向学生传递错误的信息。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Learning should be about studying new things and being responsible.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 学习应当是学习新事物和承担责任。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: Personally,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 就我个人而言，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I think the students who aren't interested in studying will simply take the easy courses to keep their average grade high and get the cash.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我认为那些对学习没兴趣的学生会为了保持高平均分、拿到现金而只选容易的课程。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: I believe that we should focus more on rewarding,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 我认为我们更应该着重奖励，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.text: excellent universities and teachers and not on students who might be lazy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_200edc016c5ef4e.zh: 优秀的大学和教师，而不是可能懒惰的学生。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Besides,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: we don't want to pay them a lot.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 我们不想给他们很多钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: I think we're simply giving them an option.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 我认为我们只是给他们一个选择。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Stay at university and be paid or get a minimum wage job.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 留在大学并获得补助，或者去做一份最低工资的工作。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Christine Thorne is a parent with two children at university.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 克里斯汀·索恩是一位有两个孩子在上大学的家长。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Hello.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 你好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: I was very worried when I heard about this new program.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 听说这个新项目时，我非常担心。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: I realize that students need encouragement to stay at university,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 我明白学生需要鼓励才能留在大学，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: but are we going in the right direction?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 但我们的方向对吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: First of all,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 首先，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: I feel that we're sending the students the wrong message.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 我觉得我们在向学生传递错误的信息。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Learning should be about studying new things and being responsible.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 学习应当是学习新事物和承担责任。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Personally,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 就我个人而言，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: I think the students who aren't interested in studying will simply take the easy courses to keep their average grade high and get the cash.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 我认为那些对学习没兴趣的学生会为了保持高平均分、拿到现金而只选容易的课程。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: I believe that we should focus more on rewarding,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 我认为我们更应该着重奖励，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: excellent universities and teachers and not on students who might be lazy.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 优秀的大学和教师，而不是可能懒惰的学生。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: These are all good points, but I don't think that this view applies to all students.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 这些都是好观点，但我不认为这种看法适用于所有学生。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Not all parents are educated or interested in studying.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 并非所有父母都受过教育或对学习感兴趣。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: They pass this bad attitude on to their own children.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 他们会把这种不好的态度传给自己的孩子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Then the children don't see the benefits of learning.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 这样孩子们就看不到学习的好处。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: To change this image,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 为了改变这种印象，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: we need to show them a good reason for studying.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 我们需要向他们展示学习的充分理由。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Thank you.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 谢谢。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.text: Let's have a look now at some of the comments we've received during the program.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_71f2913def237ad.zh: 现在来看看节目期间收到的一些评论。
